sourceReferences.title: Microsoft Learn: Posting group setup
sourceReferences.relevance: Posting groups are the Business Central mechanism that maps customers, vendors, items and documents to G/L accounts.

sourceReferences.title: Microsoft Learn: Set up value-added tax
sourceReferences.relevance: VAT posting setup combines VAT business and product posting groups and stores VAT %, calculation type and VAT G/L accounts.

proved: A customer/item posting-field write is not unlocked by TARGET-044D field visibility alone.
U-CUST-100 needs at least Customer Posting Group, Gen. Bus. Posting Group, VAT Bus. Posting Group and Payment Terms classification before O2C.
U-ITEM-HW100 needs at least Base Unit, Item Posting Group, Gen. Prod. Posting Group, VAT Prod. Posting Group and Costing Method classification before O2C/P2P.
INLAND and WAREN are proven prerequisite posting groups, but not a complete General Posting Setup or master-data field proof.
VAT field candidates remain blocked by the parked VAT Posting Setup boundary.
The next best step is TARGET-045A-CUSTOMER-ITEM-FIELD-SOURCE-MAPPING, a local source/value mapping case.
notProved: No customer posting fields are proven saved on U-CUST-100.

No VAT Posting Setup row is proven for INLAND/VAT19.
No General Posting Setup row is proven for INLAND/WAREN with 4400/5400.
No Inventory Posting Setup correctness is proven.

warnings: Posting groups are necessary setup context, not posting truth by themselves.
TARGET-045A must not become a write case unless exact field/value targets and unresolved setup boundaries are separated first.

nextStepDecision.lastEvidenceSummary: TARGET-044D inspected U-CUST-100 and U-ITEM-HW100 read-only, but did not expose enough posting/VAT/inventory field and value truth for a safe write. TARGET-031B/032B prove selected posting-group prerequisites, while TARGET-027D24 and TARGET-032F keep VAT Posting Setup and General Posting Setup parked.
nextStepDecision.reason: A no-write field-fit decision is still the safest step because Business Central posting groups and VAT posting setup determine later G/L/VAT account selection; visible customer/item card labels alone are not posting readiness.
